item.title: Armin van Buuren and David Guetta Unite for Debut Collab: ‘In The Dark’
item.description: The dance music world is abuzz with excitement as two of its most iconic figures, Armin van Buuren and David Guetta, reveal their first-ever collaboration. The long-awaited single, titled ‘In the Dark,’ dropped today on Armada Music, just weeks after the pair teased the track during their second-ever back-to-back set [...]

item.title: New Release: MARTIN GARRIX – SMILE
item.description: Martin Garrix is ​​back with what will undoubtedly be one of the hits of the summer! ‘Smile’, together with Carolina Liar, is an uplifting, optimistic song that automatically makes you smile.

item.title: Cosmic Gate & Arnej – Trifecta
item.description: Cosmic Gate’s new single ‘Trifecta’, is itself a ’trifecta’ between Nic, Bossi and distinguished Canadian producer Arnej. Their trio’s first reteaming since ‘Sometimes They Come Back For More’ a dozen years ago, the track’s a brooding, pulsing, propellant slice of tech, that’s all set to roll across late summer floors.
